title: Understanding the Loss Function
text: The loss function is given by $$L(theta)=y_i-\operatorname{f_{\theta}}\left(x_i\right)$$. This means the loss is the difference between the actual value $$y_i$$ and the predicted value $$\operatorname{f_{\theta}}\left(x_i\right)$$.

title: Gradient Descent Update Rule
text: The gradient descent update rule is given by $${\theta}^{t+1}={\theta}^t-\alpha gradient$$. Here, alpha is the learning rate, and gradient is the derivative of the loss function with respect to theta.

title: Partial Derivative with Respect to $$\Theta_1$$
text: To find the partial derivative of the loss function with respect to $$\theta_1$$, differentiate $$L(theta)=y_i-\operatorname{f_{\theta}}\left(x_i\right)$$ with respect to $$\theta_1$$.

title: Calculate the Partial Derivative
text: Differentiate the expression $$\operatorname{f_{\theta}}\left(x\right)=0.5\theta_0+\theta_0 \theta_1 x_1+sin\left(\theta_1\right) x_2$$ with respect to $$\theta_1$$.

title: Substitute Values into the Update Equation
text: Now that you have the partial derivative, substitute it into the gradient descent update equation for $$\theta_1$$.

title: Complete the Update Equation for B
text: Using the partial derivative you calculated, express B in terms of $${\theta_0}^t$$, $${\theta_1}^t$$, and any necessary constants.
